text: 陈海为什么不考虑陆亦可？
en: Why doesn't Hai Chen consider Yike Lu?

text: 陈海丧偶带娃，陆亦可未婚美女。
en: Hai Chen is widowed with a child; Yike Lu is unmarried and beautiful.

text: 陆亦可还很主动。
en: Yike Lu is also quite forward.

text: 我先生前几年单身的时候，有个领导给他介绍一个40岁单身女，未婚，银行系统，据说长得不错，把我先生吓得不行，说：40没结婚得啥脾气性格。
en: A few years ago, when my husband was single, a leader introduced him to a 40-year-old single woman, unmarried, in the banking system, supposedly quite good-looking, which terrified my husband; he said: someone unmarried at 40 must have a dreadful temper and character.

text: 我和他都是离异有孩子，我们经历过一次婚姻，太知道脾气性格多重要了。
en: Both he and I are divorced with children; we have been through one marriage and know all too well how important temperament and character are.

text: 40岁女性最大的问题在于难以取悦，举个例子，一万块的水果机，你送25+的女孩她能高兴很久，至少也会觉得男人大方，笑的和朵花一样，35+的大概率扯扯嘴角表达很开心，40+的，估计还得讽刺你两句，三五万她们都不觉得是大钱，哪怕自己没有。
en: The biggest problem with 40-year-old women is that they are hard to please. For example, a fruit machine worth ten thousand yuan: give it to a girl of 25-plus and she will be happy for a long time, or at the very least think the man generous and smile like a flower; a 35-plus woman will most likely just twitch the corners of her mouth to show she is pleased; a 40-plus woman will probably even make a couple of sarcastic remarks — tens of thousands of yuan they do not even regard as serious money, even if they have none themselves.

text: 作为40+女性，最郁闷的是，哪怕你好好保养，一年花几万块做医美，头发该白白，眼睛该花花，哪怕你节食减肥运动，瑜伽普拉提控糖，你熬个夜，立马打回原形，而且身体的衰老，是花钱没法解决的，而且大部分40+的女性，是没有闲钱去折腾自己，有钱折腾自己的，不缺男人，不用相亲。
en: As a 40-plus woman, the most depressing thing is this: even if you take good care of yourself and spend tens of thousands a year on medical aesthetics, your hair will still go grey as it must and your eyes will still blur as they must; even if you diet, lose weight, exercise, do yoga and Pilates and keep your sugar under control, stay up one night and you snap straight back to where you started. And the body's ageing is something money cannot solve. Moreover, most 40-plus women have no spare cash to fuss over themselves; those who do have the money to fuss over themselves never lack for men and have no need of matchmaking.

text: 我有个朋友开美容院的，月入4-5个，身材颜值都在线，离异带女儿，有房有车，身边追求者就没断过，很多优质男，这朋友根本不想结婚，恋爱就好了。
en: I have a friend who runs a beauty salon, earning forty to fifty thousand a month, with figure and looks both on point, divorced with a daughter, owning a home and a car, whose stream of suitors has never once run dry — many of them fine men. This friend simply has no wish to marry; dating will do.

text: 我自己也是，结婚生子的KP完成了，自己经济独立人格独立，恋爱可以，结婚我才不要，没时间伺候男人还有和他孩子相处，老娘天下最美，照顾好我生的和生我的足矣。
en: I am the same myself: I have completed the KP of marriage and childbearing, I am financially independent and personally autonomous, dating is acceptable, but marriage I absolutely do not want — I have no time to wait on a man and get along with his children. I, your mother, am the most beautiful in all the world; it is enough to care well for the children I bore and the mother who bore me.

text: 我是实诚找了十年的同龄女
en: I am someone who honestly sought a woman my own age for ten years.

text: 后来我发现，分二种情况
en: Later I found that there are two kinds of situation.

text: 一种根本没有步入婚姻殿堂，甚至没有谈过恋爱的。
en: One kind have never even entered the hall of marriage, and have not even been in a relationship.

text: 基本上都是报复性的冷淡。
en: Essentially they are all cold in a vengeful sort of way.

text: 你差不多得有劈山救母那种气概，那种魅力，才能让她们重获少女心。
en: You would almost need the valour and charm of cleaving a mountain to rescue one's mother to make them regain their girlish heart.

text: 但是一般都缺乏自知之明。
en: But generally they lack any self-awareness.

text: 你见过姨妈来了，满脸肿的张满痘痘，又胖又红，然后跟你说她的偶像是陈坤，薛之谦，把男的像这个看齐的么？
en: Have you ever seen a woman, on her period, face swollen and covered in pimples, fat and red, then tell you her idols are Kun Chen and Zhiqian Xue, and expect men to measure themselves against those two?

text: 一路跟已婚帅哥司机打情骂俏，看得我想吐么。
en: Flirting with a married, handsome driver the whole way — did watching that make you want to throw up?

text: 另外一种虽然知道婚姻与对象不完美，不然不会离异，但是她们一般都会报复性的消费你，折腾你，提出种种物质要求，情绪要求，以及让你去帮忙照顾她们的娃…
en: The other kind, although they know that marriage and one's partner are not perfect — otherwise they would not be divorced — generally take their revenge by spending on you, torment you, raise all manner of material demands, emotional demands, and ask you to help look after their children…

text: 这个年级段，我碰到真正认识自己与生活的一位，月薪5万以上。
en: In this age bracket, the one person I met who truly understands herself and life earns over 50,000 a month.

text: 财务总监级别。
en: She was at finance-director level.

text: 我跟那财务总监谈了二天一夜，亲自送飞机场。
en: I talked with that finance director for two days and a night, and personally saw her off to the airport.

text: 飞机晚点又谈到凌晨4点。
en: The flight was delayed, so we went on talking until 4 a.m.

text: 自己花了几千，她打飞的过来也是几千。
en: I spent a few thousand of my own, and she spent a few thousand too, flying over.

text: 深受启发。
en: I was deeply inspired.

text: 是个让人尊敬的妇女。
en: She is a woman worthy of respect.

text: 潮汕美德与职场沉淀，对于生活人性的认识让我重新审视很多东西。
en: The Chaoshan virtues and her workplace grounding, and her grasp of life and human nature, made me re-examine many things.

text: 她只是被耽误了，不然肯定是个贤妻良母。
en: She had simply been held back; otherwise she would surely have made a devoted wife and mother.

text: 但比例只有10%…
en: But the proportion is only 10%…

text: 我自己的圈子应该算还行吧。
en: My own circle should count as fairly decent, I suppose.

text: 月薪上万以下的，基本上全军覆灭。
en: Those on a monthly income below ten thousand are, essentially, a lost cause across the board.

text: 我觉得她们能过好自己就不错了。
en: I think it is already good enough if they can live well on their own.

text: 40岁男要找的，要么是为了生孩子，要么是为了有人照顾他的生活。
en: What 40-year-old men are looking for is either someone to bear children, or someone to look after their daily life.

text: 40岁女能满足哪个？
en: Which of those can a 40-year-old woman satisfy?

text: 因为观察者只站在相亲市场的角度去考虑问题。
en: Because the observer only considers the matter from the vantage point of the matchmaking market.

text: 我是70后，身边大把四五十岁的同龄人。
en: I am a post-70s, with plenty of peers in their forties and fifties around me.

text: 了解婚恋史的，大概有小100号人。
en: Among those whose romantic histories I know, there are roughly nearly a hundred people.

text: 已婚的，未婚的，离异的…
en: Married ones, unmarried ones, divorced ones…

text: 有钱的，没钱的，先有钱做买卖赔光的。
en: Wealthy ones, penniless ones, ones who had money at first and then lost it all in business.

text: 什么条件的都有。
en: Every sort of circumstance is represented.

text: 这么多人，没有一个是去相亲市场找伴侣的。
en: Among so many people, not a single one went to the matchmaking market to find a partner.

text: 超过90%都是自由恋爱的。
en: Over 90% found their partners through free courtship.

text: 不到10%，是朋友亲友介绍的。
en: Under 10% were introduced by friends or relatives.

text: 相互之间年龄差距都不是很大。
en: The age gaps between the couples were not very large.

text: 一般都在五岁之内。
en: Generally within five years.

text: 有钱的差距就比较大了。
en: The wealthy ones had rather larger gaps.

text: 最大的能差出15岁来。
en: The widest could reach fifteen years.

text: 从我的观察样本来看，
en: From my sample of observations,

text: 超过95%的数据，都是年岁相当的夫妻。
en: Over 95% of the data are couples of comparable age.

text: 可能…
en: Perhaps…

text: 这也证明了我认识的有钱人比较少。
en: This also proves that I know relatively few wealthy people.

text: 不过我这个岁数的有钱人，家里一般都有正妻。
en: But the wealthy people of my age generally keep a proper wife at home.

text: 在外面胡搞的，虽然很多…
en: Those who fool around outside, though many…

text: 即使是正妻死了，也绝对不会去相亲市场找女人，再娶一个。
en: Even if that proper wife dies, they would absolutely never go to the matchmaking market to find a woman and marry again.

text: 换句话说…
en: In other words…

text: 一个人活到40多岁，连个靠谱的老娘们或老爷们，都需要去相亲市场找…
en: A person who has lived past forty and still needs to go to the matchmaking market to find even a reliable old girl or old bloke…

text: 这个人活的也太失败了。
en: That person's life has been a failure of the highest order.

text: 就像身高158的女性普遍不会考虑158的男性一样。
en: Just as women who are 158 cm tall generally will not consider men who are 158 cm tall.

text: 这个问题真的很狗血，四十岁的男性为什么不会找四十岁的女性，那是因为已经是四十岁了，等到了这个不上不下的年龄，生理的荷尔蒙也没有那有那么多了，冲动也没有那么强烈了。
en: This question is really such a melodramatic cliché: why won't forty-year-old men look for forty-year-old women? It is because they are already forty; once they reach this awkward, neither-here-nor-there age, the physiological hormones are no longer so abundant, and the impulses no longer so strong.

text: 这个时候的男性没结婚的多多少少都会有一点的财产底蕴了。
en: Men of this age who have not married will, more or less, have built up some financial foundation.

text: 所以到最后还要找一个老的，同岁的，把这么多年赚的钱给她，能图她什么？
en: So in the end, to take on an old, same-age woman and hand her all the money earned over so many years — what on earth could he hope to gain from her?

text: 还不如找一个年龄小的，长的漂亮的，单纯一点，自己出去一说找了一个比自己小的，面儿也有了。
en: Better to find a younger one, a pretty one, a bit more innocent; when you go out and say you have found someone younger than yourself, you have gained face as well.

text: 在没有经济需求的情况下，40岁女同样不考虑40岁男啊，邓文迪拿了默多克分手费以后，找的都是小鲜肉。
en: Without any economic need, 40-year-old women likewise do not consider 40-year-old men — after Wendi Deng took her divorce settlement from Murdoch, the men she went for were all young toy boys.

text: 前阵子相亲一位36岁的女士，如果十年前相遇有可能，现在就很难。
en: A while ago I went matchmaking with a 36-year-old lady; if we had met ten years ago it might have been possible, but now it is very difficult.

text: 今年是2024年，91年出生的我实际年龄33岁。
en: This year is 2024; I was born in '91, so my actual age is 33.

text: 咱就算一切顺利的话，今年认识、熟悉、搞定流程，那明年备孕，后年生产的话，38岁头胎，应该算是高龄产妇了吧，据不一定靠谱的科普，都说女人生孩子，头胎大龄的比同个年纪二胎的风险大。
en: Suppose everything goes smoothly: we meet this year, get acquainted and get the whole process sorted, then next year prepare for pregnancy and the year after give birth — a first child at 38 would surely count as an older mother, would it not? According to popular-science accounts that are not necessarily reliable, they all say that for women giving birth, a first child at an older age carries greater risk than a second child at the same age.

text: 那我为什么要主动承担这个风险。
en: So why should I voluntarily take on that risk?

text: 现实是不太可能一切顺利，我去见的这位女士以我粗浅的常识来看，是需要先减肥、锻炼，调整身体状态，之后才可以考虑去生孩子的，那生孩子这事还得往后稍稍…
en: The reality is it is most unlikely everything will go smoothly. From my shallow common sense, the lady I went to meet would first need to lose weight, exercise and adjust her physical condition before she could even consider having a child; so having a child would have to be put off for a while…

text: 再假设一切顺利，大概40岁生了孩子，孩子30岁的时候，咱70，以咱们这代人的身体素质，70岁开始帮忙带孩子的风险似乎有点大了…
en: Suppose again everything goes smoothly and she has a child at around 40; when the child is 30, we shall be 70, and given the physical constitution of our generation, the risk of starting to help raise the child at 70 seems a little too great…

text: 所以我的看法是，普通家庭，普通人，适合考虑婚姻的时间只有那十来年，过了，就好好想想怎么自己过吧，或者要么丁克，要么找再婚不要求生育的，否则这一辈子就是找罪受，不划算。
en: So my view is this: for ordinary families and ordinary people, the window in which it is fitting to consider marriage is only those ten-odd years. Once it has passed, one had better think seriously about how to live on one's own, or else either be childfree (DINK) or find a remarriage that places no demand for childbearing — otherwise one's whole life is simply asking for suffering, and not worth it.

text: 再补充一句，这是相亲，不是自由恋爱。
en: One further point: this is matchmaking, not free courtship.

text: 相亲市场，是市场，得按市场的规矩来。
en: The matchmaking market is a market; it must be conducted by the market's rules.
